articles.title: Nvidia is investigating Jensen Huang’s relationship with a Chinese spy
articles.description: Nvidia has announced that it is opening an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang and his relationship with Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, who was reportedly recruited by China's Ministry of State Security to spy on the company. A statement posted by the board of directors reads: The NVIDIA Board is initiating an independent investigation in light of recent reporting that founder and CEO Jensen Huang has been the target of a foreign intelligence effort. A committee of independent directors, assisted by outside independent counsel, will oversee the investigation. articles.title: Voters Put the AI Data Center Boom on Notice
articles.description: On Bloomberg This Weekend, Bloomberg News tech reporter Brody Ford explains how voter backlash against data centers could disrupt the rapid buildout of infrastructure powering the AI boom. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Ford discusses the risks for heavily indebted AI companies and whether tougher promises from newly elected officials will translate into meaningful restrictions on development. (Source: Bloomberg)
